content.summary: Implemented Enrich File.status() to separate staged vs unstaged changes

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: File.Info schema has optional stage field
File.status uses separate staged and unstaged numstat commands
Files present in both staged and unstaged appear as separate entries
Deleted files are stage annotated correctly
/file/status remains backward compatible and now includes stage
Consumers ignoring stage continue to work

data.notes: Kept the contract additive by making stage optional. Deleted entries are classified per-stage using separate diff-filter=D queries and deduplicated against numstat results.
